headline: Approved three bond resolutions for a fire training facility, Pine Hill Fire Station replacement, and station maintenance; promoted Andrew Cote to Fire Alarm Supervisor.
summary: The board approved three bond resolutions totaling up to $3.5 million for a fire training facility, replacement of the Pine Hill Fire Station, and deferred capital maintenance of fire stations. It approved a Fire Alarm Operator hiring list and promoted Andrew Cote to Fire Alarm Supervisor, and voted 2-1 to accept a letter ending Nashua Fire Rescue's relationship with chaplain Matt Michaud. The Board of Fire Commission By-Laws item was tabled until the November meeting.
decisions: Tabled the Board of Fire Commission By-Laws until the November meeting.
Approved R-26-068 authorizing bonds not to exceed $1,500,000 for design, construction and equipping of a Fire Training Facility.
Approved R-26-069 authorizing bonds not to exceed $1,000,000 for design and other ancillary costs to replace the Pine Hill Fire Station.
Approved R-26-070 authorizing bonds not to exceed $1,000,000 for deferred capital maintenance of fire stations.
Accepted a letter from Chief Buxton to discontinue Nashua Fire Rescue's relationship with chaplain Matt Michaud, 2 in favor, 1 opposed.
Approved the Fire Alarm Operator Hiring List as presented.
Approved the promotion of Fire Alarm Operator Andrew Cote to Fire Alarm Supervisor, effective TBD.
